changes: The new Family Pulse opens with the few things that matter now, one real family moment, and the next date on your calendar — all drawn from information already in your vault.
Pulse, People, Plan, House and Vault are now the five clear everyday destinations. Every existing feature is still available from the full section menu.
Choose System, Light or Dark from Appearance. Your choice stays on this device and is applied before the first frame, so dark mode never flashes bright while the app starts.
Ember Thread is fully reversible: choose Use classic Teluva at any time to return to the previous dashboard without changing or moving any family data.
